research_question: RQ1 supervised radar-to-ECG: which REM-Net components improve morphology, timing, and monitoring reliability beyond PCC?
hypothesis: The final REM-Net configuration should improve beat-normalized morphology over WSST-TCN and event-only variants while maintaining or improving R-peak timing, RR consistency, and QMR. If the gain appears only in Shape-200 PCC, the manuscript must restrict the claim to morphology rather than clinical monitoring.
dataset: MMECG primary; CR_RVS mirror only after MMECG gate passes
protocol: Representative 3-fold strict LOSO gate followed by all-fold promotion only if the multi-metric pattern is stable. All checkpoints are selected by validation criteria only.
changed_variable: One REM-Net component or loss term per ablation arm: event supervision, morphology auxiliary loss, Shape-200 PCC term, or optional alignment module.
controlled_variables: Same final-test protocol and no test-based checkpoint selection
Same optimizer, learning rate, weight decay, batch size, early stopping rule, and random seed unless a multi-seed stability run is explicitly declared
Same metric scripts and fold-macro aggregation
Same output naming convention under experiments_mmecg with tier=pilot until promotion

ablation_arms.purpose: Event-structured model without morphology MTL decoder
Same morphology-capable architecture without event supervision
Shape auxiliary loss without PCC component
Optional alignment check; retain only if multi-metric improvement is reproducible

success_criteria: A4 beats A0/A1 on Shape-200 PCC, RMSE, MAE, and/or R2 under fold-macro aggregation
A4 does not degrade QMR, R-F1@150/100/50 ms, RR error, or coverage relative to simpler event-aware arms
A2 vs A4 isolates whether event supervision matters; no event claim is allowed if beta_peak=0 matches A4
A3 vs A4 isolates whether the Shape-200 PCC term matters; no PCC-loss claim is allowed if they are equivalent
A5 is dropped unless it improves more than noise on morphology and timing metrics
checkpoint_selection: Validation-best only; never select models by test PCC, R-F1, QMR, or qualitative appearance.
expected_outputs: Per-fold metric JSON/CSV with morphology, event/timing, QMR/coverage, and efficiency where available
Failure notes for arms that do not pass promotion
Updated PAPER_CLAIM_LEDGER entries before any manuscript causal language
estimated_compute: 3-fold gate first. Do not promote to all 11 MMECG folds or CR_RVS mirror until the gate supports at least one causal claim beyond PCC.
failure_interpretation: If final REM-Net only wins on global Shape-200 PCC, reposition the paper around beat-morphology fidelity and remove or weaken claims about event structure, timing reliability, or clinical monitoring.
notes: This spec was created after advisor feedback that PCC alone is insufficient. It imports the earlier BeatAware metric philosophy without using the conference paper as a manuscript framing device.
